history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration improve the monitoring of equipment status and the clean-up of data in Umoja to ensure the effectiveness and efficiency of computing devices management.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers the recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure. The Administration has conducted a comprehensive review to ensure data accuracy and reduce inconsistencies. The results were shared with the Board. Furthermore, the Administration has mainstreamed data accuracy into its ongoing performance management framework through the development of a dedicated key performance indicator on data quality. In the recommendation contained in paragraph 228 of its report (A/79/5 (Vol. I)), the Board called for the Administration to improve the monitoring of equipment status and the clean-up of data in Umoja. The relevant steps have been taken and the required results have been demonstrated.
history.board_assessment: Given that some special political missions continue to implement this recommendation, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: Following the completion of a comprehensive data review mentioned in the Administration’s comments above relating to the recommendation in paragraph 218 of the Board’s report for the year ended 31 December 2023, the Global Asset Management Policy Service has now initiated phase II of the clean-up of data in Umoja. The Administration will be generating data quality reports to identify and isolate property items that have remained idle for over one year. These findings will be addressed directly and formally with the respective entities, rather than through the quarterly property management reports, which encompass a broader range of issues beyond data quality. This targeted approach is intended to support entities in conducting a focused review of idle property, specifically those items that have been inactive for more than 12 months.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration improve the monitoring of equipment status and the clean-up of data in Umoja, to ensure the effectiveness and efficiency of computing devices management.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Administration has reinforced Organization-wide property management practices through the annual issuance of strategic property management guidance aligned with oversight and governing body requirements, enhancements to monitoring tools and dashboards, the introduction of mechanisms to improve visibility of surplus property and facilitate redeployment, and the conduct of targeted health checks to identify and address specific weaknesses at entity level.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has reinforced Organization- wide property management practices and there has been a general downward trend in the number of equipment records with idle status, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
